channel.title: DroidDock
channel.description: Updates for DroidDock, Android virtual devices for your Mac.

item.title: DroidDock 1.0.1
item.description:
Changed

  • DroidDock now identifies itself as com.ourappsworld.app.droiddock.macos. Because the identifier is new, macOS treats it as a fresh install of the settings: you are asked to accept the Terms once more, and the update options start at their defaults. Your virtual devices, recordings and logs are untouched, as they never lived in the app's settings.
